single.title: Two actors on a changing stage
prompts: Give the woman's long scarf a subtle jacquard leaf pattern, retaining its folds. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Add small knotted tassels along the scarf's lower edge. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Give the man's purple jacket a narrow decorative seam along each lapel. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Add a small embroidered theater-mask patch to the man's jacket near its lower hem. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Add a delicate lace overlay to the lower portion of the woman's black dress, clear of her hands. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Place a compact wooden side table against the wall between the performers, behind their arms. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Set a closed script booklet on the new table. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Print 'ACT II' clearly on the script cover. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Add a plain ceramic mug beside the script. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Give the mug a small raised star motif. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Slightly extend the canvas leftward with the same interior wall. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Add a tall folded theater screen in the new left background, clear of both performers. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Give the screen three narrow wooden panels with simple arched tops. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Hang a small wooden theatrical mask on the screen's upper panel. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Add a slender picture light above the existing framed artwork on the left wall. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Light the picture lamp softly without altering either face. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Add small covered buttons to the man's jacket cuffs, preserving his crossed-arm pose. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Place a short pencil diagonally across the closed script booklet. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
Add a narrow woven runner across the side table beneath the mug and script. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.

Give the runner a simple stitched diamond border. Retain the jacquard scarf, embroidered jacket, theater screen, and script booklet. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged, especially facial features, expressions, and poses.
